"""Create a team meeting event for next Wednesday at 3 PM, lasting one hour."""
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time

from icalendar import Calendar, Event

# Determine next Wednesday (strictly after today)
now = datetime.now().astimezone()  # local timezone
today = now.date()
days_until_wednesday = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday = 2
if days_until_wednesday == 0:
    days_until_wednesday = 7  # "next Wednesday" means the upcoming one, not today
next_wednesday = today + timedelta(days=days_until_wednesday)

tz = now.tzinfo
start = datetime.combine(next_wednesday, time(15, 0), tzinfo=tz)
end = start + timedelta(hours=1)

# Build the calendar
cal = Calendar()
cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN")
cal.add("version", "2.0")

event = Event()
event.add("uid", f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendarskill")
event.add("dtstamp", datetime.now().astimezone())
event.add("summary", "Team Meeting")
event.add("dtstart", start)
event.add("dtend", end)
event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
event.add("sequence", 0)

# 15-minute reminder
from icalendar import Alarm

alarm = Alarm()
alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
alarm.add("description", "Team meeting starting soon!")
alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
event.add_component(alarm)

cal.add_component(event)

ics_bytes = cal.to_ical()
with open("team_meeting.ics", "wb") as f:
    f.write(ics_bytes)

# Validate by re-parsing
with open("team_meeting.ics", "rb") as f:
    parsed = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
for component in parsed.walk():
    if component.name == "VEVENT":
        print("SUMMARY:", component.get("summary"))
        print("DTSTART:", component.get("dtstart").dt)
        print("DTEND:", component.get("dtend").dt)
        print("STATUS:", component.get("status"))
        print("UID:", component.get("uid"))
print("Timezone used:", tz)
print("Valid ICS file written to team_meeting.ics")

today = now.date()
days_until_wednesday = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday=0 ... Wednesday=2
if days_until_wednesday == 0:
    days_until_wednesday = 7  # "next Wednesday" = the upcoming one, never today
next_wednesday = today + timedelta(days=days_until_wednesday)

    for ch in line:

        parts.append(current)
    return "\r\n ".join(parts)

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time, timezone

now = datetime.now().astimezone()  # local time, with offset
today = now.date()
days_until_wednesday = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday=0 ... Wednesday=2
if days_until_wednesday == 0:
    days_until_wednesday = 7  # "next Wednesday" = the upcoming one, never today
next_wednesday = today + timedelta(days=days_until_wednesday)

tz = now.tzinfo
start_local = datetime.combine(next_wednesday, time(15, 0), tzinfo=tz)
end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)

# --- Convert to UTC for the ICS file ---
start_utc = start_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)
end_utc = end_local.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def fmt_utc(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def fold(line, limit=75):
    """RFC 5545 line folding: max 75 octets, continuation lines begin with a space."""
    if len(line.encode("utf-8")) <= limit:
        return line
    parts = []
    current = ""
    for ch in line:
        if len((current + ch).encode("utf-8")) > limit:
            parts.append(current)
            current = ch
        else:
            current += ch
    if current:
        parts.append(current)
    return "\r\n ".join(parts)

"""Create a team meeting event for next Wednesday at 3 PM, lasting one hour."""
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time

from icalendar import Calendar, Event

# Determine next Wednesday (strictly after today)
now = datetime.now().astimezone()  # local timezone
today = now.date()
days_until_wednesday = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday = 2
if days_until_wednesday == 0:
    days_until_wednesday = 7  # "next Wednesday" means the upcoming one, not today
next_wednesday = today + timedelta(days=days_until_wednesday)

tz = now.tzinfo
start = datetime.combine(next_wednesday, time(15, 0), tzinfo=tz)
end = start + timedelta(hours=1)

# Build the calendar
cal = Calendar()
cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN")
cal.add("version", "2.0")

event = Event()
event.add("uid", f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendarskill")
event.add("dtstamp", datetime.now().astimezone())
event.add("summary", "Team Meeting")
event.add("dtstart", start)
event.add("dtend", end)
event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
event.add("sequence", 0)

# 15-minute reminder
from icalendar import Alarm

alarm = Alarm()
alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
alarm.add("description", "Team meeting starting soon!")
alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
event.add_component(alarm)

cal.add_component(event)

ics_bytes = cal.to_ical()
with open("team_meeting.ics", "wb") as f:
    f.write(ics_bytes)

# Validate by re-parsing
with open("team_meeting.ics", "rb") as f:
    parsed = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
for component in parsed.walk():
    if component.name == "VEVENT":
        print("SUMMARY:", component.get("summary"))
        print("DTSTART:", component.get("dtstart").dt)
        print("DTEND:", component.get("dtend").dt)
        print("STATUS:", component.get("status"))
        print("UID:", component.get("uid"))
print("Timezone used:", tz)
print("Valid ICS file written to team_meeting.ics")
